strategy.overview: Millionaire has no lock qualification. Shoot the right orbit to place a ball in the left wire-ramp lock, and shoot the left plastic ramp to place a ball in the right horseshoe lock. Filling both starts two-ball Multiball. Re-lock both balls during Multiball for the progressive Emerald, Ruby, Diamond, then repeating Hotshot payoffs.
strategy.simpleOverview: Shoot the right orbit for the left lock and the left plastic ramp for the right lock; there are no prerequisites. The second lock starts two-ball Multiball. During Multiball, re-lock both balls to collect Emerald, Ruby, Diamond, then 500K Hotshot payoffs.
strategy.summary: With no prerequisites, shoot the right orbit and left plastic ramp to fill the two opposite-side locks. The second lock starts two-ball Multiball. Re-lock both balls for Emerald, Ruby, Diamond, then Hotshot payoffs.

quickInfo.name: Left Lock
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the right orbit; it lands in the left wire-ramp lock.

quickInfo.name: Right Lock
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the left plastic ramp; it lands in the right horseshoe lock.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Fill both locks in either order.

quickInfo.name: Collect Payoffs
quickInfo.summary: During Multiball, re-lock both balls for each progressive award.

steps.text: Shoot the right orbit to lock a ball at the left wire ramp.
Shoot the left plastic ramp to lock a ball in the right horseshoe; the second filled lock starts two-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, shoot both lock routes again to re-lock both balls and collect the current payoff.
Repeat for Emerald, Ruby, Diamond, then the fixed Hotshot payoff on later completions.

alternatives.title: Spin the Wheel of Riches
alternatives.when: Use this when an opposing inlane has lit an eject hole.

steps.text: Shoot a lit eject hole to spin the physical Wheel of Riches.
Multiball occupies two of the twelve wheel positions, but the result is random; use the direct locks for a guaranteed start.
Use the moving shooter-lane guide to reach the upper-left Gold Bar targets.
Advance the targets for 2x, 3x, and 5x end-of-ball bonus while briefly opening the right outlane return gate.

machineSetup: Confirm lock stealing, Wheel of Riches extra-ball and Special settings, and progressive payoff values.
Test both lock routes and releases, moving shooter-lane guide, Gold Bar targets, both eject holes, physical prize wheel, outlane gates, and trough.

cautions.issue: A shot toward an already occupied lock swaps the balls instead of adding another lock.
cautions.response: Track which side is occupied and shoot the opposite route to start Multiball.
